standards_review.notes: 9 subjects in the review range all match the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format
New run-file validation appended to ~958-line workflow_executions.py router and duplicates AgentWorkspaceService._validate_run_file.
is_safe_blob_ref applied before all download rules and in workspace sync; cap and ownership checked on the route; unsafe tokens skipped without logging values.

findings.title: Run-file validation duplicated in router
findings.problem: _validate_run_files_and_raise repeats the decode, safe-ref and can_download checks already in AgentWorkspaceService._validate_run_file, calls private _decode_workspace_file_url and _normalize_file_url from outside the class, and adds a new concern to a ~958-line router (code-quality Module Cohesion).
findings.impact: Blocking code-quality standard in this workflow; the two copies of safety and ownership checks can drift apart. Only the service copy checks blob existence.
findings.recommendation: Expose a public service method (reuse _validate_run_file logic) or a small module for run-file validation, and have the router call it; keep the count cap check in one place.

findings.title: Share grant (rule E) unreachable at run start
findings.problem: Both the router check and AgentWorkspaceService._validate_run_file call can_download with share_token=None, so rule E can never pass. AC9 requires the same rules A-E; own workspace-<id> and share-grant accept tests are absent at register_run_files and router level.
findings.impact: A user running a workflow on files from a conversation shared with them gets a 400, and AC9 is only partially met. Whether this is intended is not stated in the spec; fixing it requires a request-shape or contract decision (e.g. accepting a share token).
findings.recommendation: Decide: either accept a share token on the run request and pass it through both checks (with accept tests), or amend the spec/AC to exclude rule E and document it.

findings.title: Missing blob can yield 500; existence check reads blob
findings.problem: _validate_run_file catches only FileNotFoundError around file_repository.read_file. The AWS repository re-raises BotoCoreError/ClientError and the Azure repository re-raises generic exceptions, so a missing blob on those backends escapes as a non-ValidationException. The check also loads up to 20 files of full content into memory just to test existence.
findings.impact: Missing-blob requests return 500 instead of 400 on cloud storage backends (the AC2 missing-blob rejection holds only for filesystem/GCP), and each run request can cause large memory and latency spikes. Reachability confirmed by reading the repository implementations.
findings.recommendation: Use a metadata or exists check where available, and map backend not-found errors (FileNotFoundError, KeyError, OSError, ClientError NoSuchKey, Azure ResourceNotFound) to ValidationException(...) from exc.

findings.title: Registered run files orphaned on later failure
findings.problem: register_run_files persists a workspace and file rows keyed by the newly minted execution_id before conversation creation and WorkflowExecution.save. If either later step raises, nothing removes the workspace; test_db_error_on_save_fails_creation asserts only propagation.
findings.impact: Orphan workspace and file rows for an execution id that never existed accumulate on each failed run creation.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the later steps in try/except that calls AgentWorkspaceRepository().delete_by_execution_id(execution_id) (best-effort) and re-raises; add a test asserting cleanup.
